notes.title: MOM [PATCH 4.0]
notes.notes:
Hello!


It’s been a while since I last patched MOM, but I’ve been reading the reviews and noticed a few things I wanted to improve. Here’s what’s new:

There were some complaints about the translation near the end of the game — we've improved it.

Fixed a few remaining minor bugs.

Replaced the game's splash art at the beginning with the new ones I'm currently using.

Polished some of the dialogue.

Updated the Steam SDK for better compatibility.

Even though MOM was my first game, I’m still very fond of it and want to keep it as polished as possible. So I’ll continue reading your feedback to see if there’s anything else to fix or improve.

As part of the Steam Summer Sale, MOM will be 75% off ($0.99) for a few weeks — in case anyone hasn’t had the chance to play it yet.

I also want to thank you all for the almost 500 copies sold — it really means a lot! :)

Aside from MOM, I’m currently working on UNRETURNING, a 16-bit horror and adventure game. You can add it to your wishlist (which I greatly appreciate!) here: 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3625960/UNRETURNING/?l=spanish"][/dynamiclink]You can also follow me on X or Bluesky to stay up to date with news: https://x.com/1cursedcat
And we’ve also got a Discord server: https://discord.gg/akfpMWF2wt

Thank you so much! 🙏
